settings.crawl.task_interval_minutes.why: The upstream project recommends at least 15–30 minutes. Web search often lags the app by 10–40 minutes, so shorter intervals do not reveal newly listed items sooner.
settings.crawl.task_interval_minutes.ris: Intervals below 15 minutes are more likely to trigger verification; running every 2 minutes has triggered it in reports. No frequency is proven safe.
settings.crawl.task_interval_minutes.rec: 30–120 minutes; applies as the default for new tasks.
settings.crawl.interval_jitter_percent.w: After each run, randomly extend the interval without shortening it so runs are not always evenly spaced.
settings.crawl.interval_jitter_percent.r: Zero disables the random extension. Larger values can increase the wait until the next run.
At least 0; the default randomly extends intervals by 0–30%.
settings.crawl.account_min_gap_seconds.w: Repeated searches in a short time may trigger RGV587. Tasks, login, and verification sessions on the same account all share this gap.
settings.crawl.account_min_gap_seconds.r: A short gap can make multiple tasks search in rapid succession.
At least 120 seconds; the default is 180 seconds plus a random extension.
settings.crawl.account_min_gap_jitter_se: Add a random wait to the account gap. It is chosen and saved when the session ends, and is not redrawn after a restart.
Zero disables the extension. Larger values delay the next session for this account.
At least 0; the default adds 0–60 seconds.
settings.crawl.account_hourly_visits.why: One project reported no verification at about 25 visits per hour, but many RGV587 errors at 129. Visits are counted over a rolling 60-minute window.
settings.crawl.account_hourly_visits.ris: There is no supporting evidence for exceeding 40 visits per hour; verification may become more frequent.
settings.crawl.account_hourly_visits.rec: At most 40 visits; the default is 30.
settings.crawl.account_daily_search_visi: Limit the daily total of home, search, filter, and pagination visits. Failures and retries count too. The default is conservative.
A higher limit permits more daily visits. Changing time zone, moving the clock backward, or restarting does not restore quota.
settings.crawl.account_daily_detail_visi: Detail pages carry the highest risk. The default of 100 is more conservative than the previous 150. Seller profiles and credit or review actions also count.
Increasing the limit opens more high-risk pages; reports describe detail pages being blocked one after another.
settings.crawl.max_pages.label: Default pages per task
settings.crawl.max_pages.why: With newest-first sorting, the first page contains the latest items and is usually enough at a 30-minute interval.
settings.crawl.max_pages.risk: Each extra page adds a visit and a page wait.
settings.crawl.max_pages.recommendation: 1–3 pages; applies as the default for new tasks.
settings.crawl.page_wait_seconds.label: Wait between pages
settings.crawl.page_wait_seconds.why: Pause before reading another page, following the upstream and existing 10–15 second interval.
settings.crawl.page_wait_seconds.risk: Shorter waits make page visits more frequent. No frequency is guaranteed safe.
settings.crawl.page_wait_seconds.recomme: Minimum wait of at least 10 seconds.
settings.crawl.max_details_per_run.label: Detail and seller pages per run
settings.crawl.max_details_per_run.why: A report triggered verification on the fourth detail page. The upstream project advises against opening many details at once. Detail and seller pages share this limit.
settings.crawl.max_details_per_run.risk: More than 10 concentrates many detail visits into one run.
settings.crawl.detail_pre_wait_seconds.w: Allow time to look at the listing before opening a detail page.
settings.crawl.detail_pre_wait_seconds.r: Short waits concentrate detail visits into a shorter period.
Minimum wait of at least 2 seconds.
settings.crawl.detail_stay_seconds.label: Stay on a detail page
settings.crawl.detail_stay_seconds.why: The upstream default was 15–30 seconds. Verification reports increased after it changed to 5–10 seconds; this is a timing correlation, not proven causation.
settings.crawl.detail_stay_seconds.risk: Very short stays look more like repeated machine visits.
settings.crawl.detail_stay_seconds.recom: Minimum of at least 8 seconds; the default is 10–20.
settings.crawl.action_wait_seconds.label: Wait between ordinary actions
settings.crawl.action_wait_seconds.why: Pause between actions such as filter clicks, following the upstream and existing 1–3 second wait.
settings.crawl.action_wait_seconds.risk: Shorter waits make requests more frequent.
settings.crawl.action_wait_seconds.recom: Minimum wait of at least 1 second.
settings.crawl.home_stay_seconds.label: Stay on the home page
settings.crawl.home_stay_seconds.why: Stay on the home page and scroll once before searching, as used upstream since PR #300.
settings.crawl.home_stay_seconds.risk: Searching immediately after opening the home page looks less like manual browsing.
settings.crawl.home_stay_seconds.recomme: Minimum stay of at least 2 seconds.
settings.crawl.typing_interval_ms.label: Delay between typed characters
settings.crawl.typing_interval_ms.why: Type the search phrase character by character; 50–130 milliseconds follows voltwake/xianyu-monitor.
settings.crawl.typing_interval_ms.risk: Longer intervals increase typing time. No typing speed is proven safe.
settings.crawl.typing_interval_ms.recomm: The default is 50–130 milliseconds; no universal range is established.
settings.crawl.seller_cache_hours.label: Seller information cache lifetime
settings.crawl.seller_cache_hours.why: Reuse recently fetched seller data to avoid repeatedly opening the same profile. The default is 24 hours.
settings.crawl.seller_cache_hours.risk: Short lifetimes repeat profile visits; long lifetimes use older seller information.
settings.crawl.quiet_hours.label: Daily quiet hours
settings.crawl.quiet_hours.why: Match your routine. The idea that people browse less overnight is an assumption without direct evidence; fewer items are listed overnight.
settings.crawl.quiet_hours.risk: Disabling quiet hours or using equal start and end times allows runs all day. Harm is not proven, but it differs from typical manual browsing.
settings.crawl.quiet_hours.recommendatio: Match your routine; the default is 01:00–07:30 and may span midnight.
settings.crawl.global_pages.label: Global open-page limit
settings.crawl.global_pages.why: A heavy page reached about 1 GB of container memory in tests. Login, verification, and retained Chrome sessions also occupy slots. Each account always has one page.
settings.crawl.global_pages.risk: Insufficient memory can crash browsers. This limit does not allow parallel pages on the same account.
settings.crawl.verify_hold_minutes.label: Keep the browser after verification appears
settings.crawl.verify_hold_minutes.why: Allow time to open the original page after receiving a notification, avoiding another page visit.
settings.crawl.verify_hold_minutes.risk: Too short may leave too little time; too long holds a page slot and may block other accounts. After the viewer opens, the session still lasts at most 10 minutes.
settings.crawl.verify_cooldown_base_minu: The first cooldown defaults to 2 hours and doubles after repeated verification. Immediate retries can trigger verification again.
Short cooldowns can trigger verification again. Longer cooldowns delay this account’s tasks.
Start at the default of 120 minutes, then double after repeats.
settings.crawl.verify_cooldown_max_minut: Repeated cooldowns double without growing indefinitely; the default maximum is 24 hours.
A low maximum may allow runs before recovery. A longer maximum delays tasks.
The default is 1440 minutes and must not be below the initial cooldown.
settings.crawl.verify_cooldown_reset_hou: Restore the initial cooldown only after a period without another verification trigger; the default is 24 hours.
A short period resets the cooldown level sooner. A longer one retains the doubled level longer.
Reset after the default of 24 hours without another trigger.
settings.crawl.deny_pause_hours.label: Pause after direct denial
settings.crawl.deny_pause_hours.why: Stop this account after a direct denial or environment block. The default 24 hours follows the upstream circuit breaker.
settings.crawl.deny_pause_hours.risk: Short pauses may lead to another denial in the same environment. Check the browser sandbox, WebGL, and proxy.
settings.crawl.failure_threshold.label: Ordinary failure threshold
settings.crawl.failure_threshold.why: Pause a task after consecutive network, timeout, or layout failures. Risk-control errors do not count as ordinary failures.
settings.crawl.failure_threshold.risk: A higher value permits more attempts during persistent failures. A lower value pauses sooner.
settings.crawl.failure_threshold.recomme: The default is 3 consecutive failures; no universal range is established.
settings.crawl.failure_pause_minutes.why: Temporarily pause a task after consecutive ordinary failures to avoid repeated attempts.
settings.crawl.failure_pause_minutes.ris: Shorter pauses retry failed tasks sooner. Longer pauses delay recovery.
settings.crawl.failure_pause_minutes.rec: The default is 30 minutes; no universal range is established.
settings.crawl.run_timeout_minutes.label: Run timeout
settings.crawl.run_timeout_minutes.why: Limit how long one run occupies a browser; the default is 15 minutes.
settings.crawl.run_timeout_minutes.risk: A short timeout can interrupt unfinished work. A long timeout holds the account and a global page slot.
settings.crawl.run_timeout_minutes.recom: The default is 15 minutes; no universal range is established.
settings.ai.max_items_per_run.label: Items analyzed per run
settings.ai.max_items_per_run.why: Limit the combined total of third-layer and keyword analysis. Batch title screening does not count.
settings.ai.max_items_per_run.risk: Higher values increase model usage per run. Lower values leave more items for later processing.
settings.ai.image_count.label: Images sent per item
settings.ai.image_count.why: Use the first detail images, limited to the number available. Search thumbnails are not substituted.
settings.ai.image_count.risk: Each image uses more tokens. Some providers limit the number of images per request; exceeding that limit may mark the provider as not supporting images. Reduce the image count and save the provider again.
settings.ai.image_count.recommendation: 1–4 images recommended; larger values are allowed without automatic image reduction or retry.
settings.ai.max_concurrent_requests.why: All model requests share a server-wide limit; the default is 2 concurrent requests.
settings.ai.max_concurrent_requests.risk: Higher values may reach provider rate limits sooner or increase simultaneous usage.
settings.ai.max_concurrent_requests.reco: The default is 2; no universal range is established.
settings.ai.request_timeout_seconds.why: Set a deadline for each model request; the default is 90 seconds.
settings.ai.request_timeout_seconds.risk: Short timeouts may interrupt slow models. Long timeouts hold request slots longer.
settings.ai.request_timeout_seconds.reco: The default is 90 seconds; no universal range is established.
settings.ai.proxy_id.label: Model proxy
settings.ai.proxy_id.why: Affects model requests only, not Xianyu browsing or notifications.
settings.ai.proxy_id.risk: Model requests fail if the proxy is unavailable. Unbind the proxy before deleting it.
settings.ai.proxy_id.recommendation: Use a direct connection when no proxy is selected.
settings.ai.daily_token_limit.label: Daily token limit
settings.ai.daily_token_limit.why: Count input and output tokens across all providers by calendar day in the configured time zone.
settings.ai.daily_token_limit.risk: Zero means unlimited usage. Changing time zone, moving the clock backward, restarting, or clearing business data does not restore the day’s budget.
settings.ai.daily_token_limit.recommenda: Choose a limit for your budget; the default 0 means unlimited.
settings.notify.link_target.label: Item link target
settings.notify.link_target.why: Item links in notifications can open the mobile app or website.
settings.notify.link_target.risk: The receiving device must support Xianyu app links when the app is selected.
settings.notify.link_target.recommendati: Mobile app by default; the website is also available.
settings.notify.max_per_run.label: Notifications per run
settings.notify.max_per_run.why: The total per task run includes a combined notification; one slot is reserved for a summary when needed.
settings.notify.max_per_run.risk: Higher limits send more notifications. Lower limits combine more items; the summary does not exceed the limit.
settings.notify.max_per_run.recommendati: The default is 5; a limit of 1 is allowed.
settings.notify.system_channel_ids.label: System event notification channels
settings.notify.system_channel_ids.why: Choose channels for system events such as account or model errors. An empty list means all enabled channels.
settings.notify.system_channel_ids.risk: Clearing the selection does not disable system notifications; it uses all enabled channels.
settings.notify.system_channel_ids.recom: Choose as needed; all enabled channels are used by default.
settings.general.language.label: Language
settings.general.language.why: Affects Kakatta interface and notification text only. Chrome always uses Simplified Chinese.
settings.general.language.risk: Original model and seller text is not translated with the interface.
settings.general.appearance.label: Appearance
settings.general.appearance.why: Choose a dark, light, or system-matched appearance.
settings.general.appearance.risk: Only changes Kakatta’s appearance, not the browsing environment.
settings.general.timezone.label: Time zone
settings.general.timezone.why: Calendar-day quotas, daily usage, and quiet hours use this time zone. Chrome uses it for TZ too.
settings.general.timezone.risk: Changing time zone does not restore quota early. Unfinished day windows from previous time zones remain active.
settings.general.timezone.recommendation: Use TZ by default, or Asia/Shanghai when it is absent.
settings.general.public_url.label: Public URL
settings.general.public_url.why: The “View in Kakatta” notification link uses this address. An empty value omits the link.
settings.general.public_url.risk: An incorrect address breaks notification links. Do not include credentials.
settings.general.public_url.recommendati: Use your actual full HTTP or HTTPS address, or leave it empty.
settings.general.update_check.label: Check for updates
settings.general.update_check.why: Check GitHub Releases once a day. New versions are announced without updating the server automatically.
settings.general.update_check.risk: Enabling this contacts GitHub. Disabling it stops automatic update notices.
settings.general.onboarding_done.label: Onboarding completed
settings.general.onboarding_done.why: Record whether initial onboarding is complete.
settings.general.onboarding_done.risk: Changing this flag does not delete saved accounts, providers, or tasks.
settings.general.onboarding_done.recomme: Incomplete by default on a new installation.
settings.security.trusted_proxies.label: Trusted reverse proxies
settings.security.trusted_proxies.why: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers only from these sources when identifying the client IP. An empty list uses the connection source IP.
settings.security.trusted_proxies.risk: An overly broad range may allow spoofed client IPs. This setting is read-only when supplied by the environment.
settings.security.trusted_proxies.recomm: List only proxy IPs or CIDR ranges you control.
settings.retention.findings_days.label: Result retention
settings.retention.findings_days.why: Automatically delete findings older than the retention period. Saved findings are not automatically deleted.
settings.retention.findings_days.risk: Cleanup deletes old results. Keeping them forever uses increasing disk space.
settings.retention.findings_days.recomme: 7, 30, 90 days, or forever; the default is 30 days.
settings.retention.run_steps_days.label: Step log retention
settings.retention.run_steps_days.why: Keep recent step-by-step run logs for the log page; the default is 14 days.
settings.retention.run_steps_days.risk: Shorter retention removes access to older step logs. Longer retention uses more disk space.
settings.retention.run_steps_days.recomm: The default is 14 days; choose according to troubleshooting needs.
settings.retention.stats_days.label: Statistics retention
settings.retention.stats_days.why: Run, model, notification, and market records support 30-day statistics; the default retention is 31 days.
settings.retention.stats_days.risk: When retention is shorter than the selected period, statistics include only remaining data.
settings.retention.stats_days.recommenda: The default is 31 days. Shorter values are allowed with an incomplete-statistics warning.
settings.retention.seller_profile_days.w: Clean up seller records that have not been refreshed for a long time, separately from the cache reuse lifetime in hours.
settings.retention.seller_profile_days.r: After cleanup, needing the information again requires another seller profile visit.
The default is 30 days; no universal range is established.
settings.retention.orphan_listing_days.w: Only clean up listings with no findings or market references, no saved status, and no recent sightings.
settings.retention.orphan_listing_days.r: Eligible listings and their price points are deleted together.
The default is 30 days; no universal range is established.
settings.cache.image_max_mb.label: Thumbnail cache limit
settings.cache.image_max_mb.why: Evict least recently used thumbnails to limit total cache disk usage.
settings.cache.image_max_mb.risk: Lower limits cause more image downloads. Higher limits use more disk space.
settings.cache.image_max_mb.recommendati: The default is 500 MB; adjust to available disk space.
settings.cache.browser_cache_mb.label: Browser cache limit per account
settings.cache.browser_cache_mb.why: Use Chrome’s disk-cache-size to limit the disk cache for each account.
settings.cache.browser_cache_mb.risk: Each account has a separate cache, so more accounts increase total disk usage.
settings.cache.browser_cache_mb.recommen: The default is 256 MB per account.
settings.cleanup.interval_hours.label: Cleanup interval
settings.cleanup.interval_hours.why: Clean up once at startup, then check expired data and cache at this interval.
settings.cleanup.interval_hours.risk: Longer intervals retain expired data longer. Shorter intervals run cleanup more often.
